_doc: Motedis Aluprofil 30x30L I-Typ Nut 6: a 30 mm aluminium profile, light, made to match item's Line 6 (profile-3030-item-6l). Outer size, opening, slot depth, bore and the section figures are from Motedis' own data picture; what it does not print (the cavity's width, the corner radius, the corner hollows) is item's figure or scaled off item's drawing, and says so. The drawn outline leaves out the hollow behind each lip of the light groove and the rounds in the hollows, so it comes out heavier than Motedis' figures.
